text:
𝗠𝗨𝗠𝗕𝗔𝗜 𝟴 𝗙𝗢𝗥 𝟯𝟲! 😳

Mumbai were 173/2 after 15 overs, then all out for 209. Suchith took Sarfaraz, Dube and Suryakumar in one over.

They still won by 86 runs. Wild T20? 👇
#SMAT #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗠𝗨𝗠𝗕𝗔𝗜 𝗞𝗔 𝗞𝗛𝗔𝗟𝗕𝗔𝗟𝗜 𝗖𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗔𝗣𝗦𝗘! 😳🏏

👉 SMAT mein Mumbai 173/2 the, phir 209 pe all out
👉 Suchith ne ek hi over mein Sarfaraz, Dube aur Suryakumar ko out kiya
👉 Phir bhi Mumbai ne Uttarakhand ko 123 pe samet kar 86 runs se match jeeta

Kya yeh sabse ajeeb T20 collapse tha? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #SMAT #Mumbai
